results.message: Do not make any moves. What is the difference between a maintenance horizon and job duration?
results.text: A maintenance horizon refers to the estimated time window before a vehicle is due for its next scheduled maintenance, based on usage and forecasts. Job duration is the actual time required in the workshop to perform the maintenance or repair work once the vehicle is booked in. The horizon helps plan when to schedule work, while duration determines how long the bay and staff are occupied.
